prompt:
Use case: realistic photographic context assets for the Chinese character 筝, meaning wind kite, in a children's Hanzi learning project.
Primary request: one 1024x1792 vertical triptych containing exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked top to bottom in equal-height panels, separated by two thin straight pure-white horizontal seams. No text anywhere.
Top photograph — exact context 空中飞着的菱形风筝: one complete diamond-shaped wind kite flying in a natural blue sky over a distant open grassy field. Show its four-point diamond outline, fabric face, slender attached kite string and entire ribbon tail clearly. Keep the whole kite and tail centered with generous space around them.
Middle photograph — exact context 空中飞着的燕形风筝: one complete traditional swallow-shaped wind kite actually flying in a natural sky, with recognizable outstretched swallow wings and forked tail, lightweight fabric over slender frame, and a fine visible attached kite string. The kite is a manufactured kite, not a living bird. Entire swallow outline comfortably contained inside this independent landscape photograph.
Bottom photograph — exact context 空中飞着的三角形风筝: one complete triangular delta wind kite flying above an open grassy meadow against a natural sky, showing the straight triangular wing outline, fabric texture, attached fine kite string and full tail, all fully within the panel.
Style and light: photorealistic camera photographs, real woven kite fabric, natural outdoor daylight, realistic wind-tension and scale, believable skies and distant terrain, not glossy synthetic rendering. Each photograph has its own backdrop and composition; do not let any object cross a seam.
Composition and safety: keep the complete main subject centrally placed with safe margins at every edge of each horizontal panel. Unobstructed open countryside only; no electrical lines, pylons, rooftops, traffic or dangerous kite-flying setting. No people required. No typography, Chinese characters, captions, labels, logo, watermark, cartoon, illustration, diagram or decorative border.
reviewNotes: Inspected only a 300x525 JPEG preview. Top shows a complete diamond kite with ribbon tail; middle shows a framed swallow-shaped kite with forked tail and visible line; bottom shows a complete triangular delta kite with ribbon tail. All are airborne over open grassland, with no electrical lines or visible text. Main kite shapes and tails remain within their panels; the top and bottom kite peaks have comparatively modest upper margins. Thin white seam bands measured from original Sharp raw RGB rows at 597–603 and 1192–1197; centers 600 and 1195.

contexts.label: 空中飞着的三角形风筝
